Half the results have no readable text, the rest are recycled-domain listicles, a generic fan-troubleshooting page, and one niche guide that admits only two makers publish a noise figure and names no 1,000 Wh pick. The only concrete claim (Elite 100 V2 at 30 dB) is under load, not while charging, and unverifiable. A page that lists 1,000 Wh units with dB readings while charging at full and reduced rates, silent-mode refill times and current prices would be the only direct answer.
